S05.meta: // SLIDE 05 — MELANOMA DATA: WHERE CSC FREQUENCY ESTIMATES CRACKED

data.question: How rare are cancer stem cells?

branches.label: Dick / AML (2008) — 1 in 250,000
branches.detail: Inadequately immunocompromised mice — assay artifact suppressed apparent frequency by ~1,000-fold

branches.label: Morrison / Melanoma — 1 in 4
branches.detail: Properly immunocompromised NOD/SCID IL2Rγ-null mice — 25% of melanoma cells initiated tumors
branches.fix: CSC frequency is assay-dependent, not a biological constant

resolver.label: The assay determines the answer
resolver.detail: A million-fold difference in apparent CSC frequency was generated by the choice of immunocompromised mouse model, not tumor biology
